items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: there was a wonderful pianist in the pit by the name of Leo Boylen

ctx.x: -- oh, I know what. I know. That last year I was in school, they was playing in the Princess Theater in Beardstown -- they had amateur contest. In the theater and there was a wonderful pianist in the pit by the name of Leo Boylen, who was a -- really a great -- he'd been with bands around territory bands --
